content.text:
Going by test counts per file and file names, the thinnest coverage is in these places. I didn't run the suite or measure line coverage, so treat it as a rough estimate.

The weakest spot is the monitor module, which has no test file of its own. The verifier has only one file of negative cases, about thirteen tests, for a module of roughly 450 lines. The barge-in code has eight tests, and the failure handler has ten.

The biggest gap by size is the wake listener, which is over 4,000 lines. Its tests are split across the sherpa wake, wake reconcile, wake while working, vocab reload and states files, and none of them target the module as a whole. The audio loop and the microphone path are meant to be tested by hand, so some of that is deliberate.

The well-covered areas are the permission hook, speech text, the crew, the adapters, chats and the lock.
